title: Heart to heart talks.
html_source:
A satirical sketch in Life (Dent, R. Colloquial Language in Ulysses: A Reference Tool). The sketch begins 7th January 1904, a date significant to Joyce.

The three lines mirror the rhythm of peristalsis, the digestive beat of the chapter-
